scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:history:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --command "SELECT roll_id, room_id, sequence, revision, authority, total, created_at, updated_at FROM roll_history ORDER BY COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc --env production
